info.title: suxen control-plane API
info.description: Administrative API for repositories, access control, retention, provenance, and operations. OCI Distribution endpoints under /v2 and /repository/{name}/v2 use the OCI error envelope and are intentionally outside this control-plane contract.

get.description: Returns stable links for the control-plane contract and repository data-plane mounts.

version.description: SemVer of this HTTP API surface, from the contract manifest.

contract.description: Independently versioned contract surfaces this build ships (SPIs, HTTP API, webhook API).

attributePaths.description: Stable attribute paths usable in policy predicates. The reserved roots are sys, classification, provenance, and every name in formats; other roots address writer-owned namespaces. Format plugins may expose additional paths under their reserved roots.

get.description: Lists declarative ownership metadata without exposing comparison hashes or secret fingerprints.

post.description: Reconciles a complete desired-state document. Requires the admin:provision:write privilege. Secret references are resolved by the server and secret values are never returned.

put.description: The driver, configuration reference and physical destination remain fixed for the resource's lifetime, including the default store. Only operational attributes can change. Credential rotation behind the same reference may require a process restart; changing destination requires a new store and drain.

post.summary: Start draining a blob store onto a target
post.description: Marks the store for migration onto the target store and blocks new repository bindings to it. Reversible with DELETE.

delete.description: Returns a draining or drained store to active and keeps every blob. Idempotent on an already-active store.

get.summary: Report physical usage of a blob store
get.description: Enumerates the backend, which the blob SPI documents as not cheap, and reports object count and bytes split into referenced blobs still in use and unreferenced blobs a prune could reclaim.

post.summary: Run garbage collection scoped to one blob store
post.description: Deletes only blobs no metadata references, scoped to one physical store whose digests are isolated from the others. Unlike the global collector it does not reap stale upload sessions. Task history remains under /api/v1/tasks.

get.summary: List repositories visible to the current principal
get.description: Bounded name-keyset traversal. Use cursor, not page; no total is returned. New repository names after the cursor may appear during traversal.

Bounded cursor scan in repository/member/path order. Each response examines at most 1,000 top-level repository rows (plus reached group members) and 1,000 asset rows. Use cursor, not page; no total is returned. Selective filters can yield empty items with nextCursor. Asset IDs are frozen at the first page; updates may appear, and deleting a cursor anchor makes it stale. Repository names are walked live, so later names can appear; a changed active repository can stale the cursor.

delete.description: Deletion returns 409 while a group, cleanup policy, or webhook references this repository, or OCI upload sessions remain. Remove the references and cancel or reap upload sessions before retrying. A later repository with the same name has separate assets and cache state.

get.description: Reads bounded pages in path order. For groups, scans members in order and returns assets from the first member at each path under the group identity. npm groups compare public formatPath values when cache paths are opaque; other formats compare stored paths to preserve query partitions. Multiple cache identities within one member remain distinct stored assets. A group page examines at most 1,000 records and may return empty items with nextCursor when assets are shadowed. Use cursor, not page; no total is returned. Cursors fix an asset-ID high-water mark: later inserts are excluded, existing asset updates may appear, and deleting a cursor anchor makes it stale. Changing group members also makes its cursor stale.

get.summary: Browse artifacts through one logical repository
get.description: Bounded cursor scan in group-member/path order. Use cursor, not page; no total is returned. Selective component filters can yield empty items with nextCursor. Asset IDs are frozen at the first page; updates may appear, and deleting a cursor anchor makes it stale.

get.summary: Browse bounded component-version rows from a repository
get.description: A hosted or proxy Raw repository with formatConfig components returns one row per component version with its member assets, ordered by component and then highest version first; limit counts components, and each page carries every version of its components; paths matching no component pattern and versions without an anchor file are omitted. Other repositories return one row per asset ordered by asset path.

200.description: At most limit component-version rows, ordered by asset path; one component can span pages

get.summary: Read an OCI manifest asset's config and layers
get.description: For a group repository, an asset ID from its component listing resolves only while visible through the group's ordered members.

200.description: Parsed manifest config, layers, sub-manifests, and subject

get.summary: Download the stored bytes for one visible asset ID
get.description: Serves the selected stored generation and applies its member repository download gate and trust policy. For groups, the ID must still be visible through the ordered members; npm member precedence compares public formatPath values rather than opaque cache keys. This route also downloads proxy cache entries whose public request URL cannot be reconstructed from their opaque storage path.

ETag.description: Quoted SHA-256 digest of the stored bytes.

Last-Modified.description: Last modification time as an HTTP date.

Content-Length.description: Number of bytes in this response.

ETag.description: Quoted SHA-256 digest of the stored bytes.

Last-Modified.description: Last modification time as an HTTP date.

Content-Length.description: Number of bytes in this response.

Content-Range.description: Selected byte range and full length, for example bytes 100-199/1000.

304.description: Representation is unchanged; no response body.

ETag.description: Quoted SHA-256 digest of the stored bytes.

Last-Modified.description: Last modification time as an HTTP date.

412.description: A read precondition failed; no response body.

416.description: The byte range cannot be satisfied.

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: One byte range, for example bytes=100-199. Unsupported multiple ranges are ignored.

parameters.name: If-Range
parameters.description: Only an exact strong digest ETag permits a partial response. A stale, weak, or date validator produces the full representation.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: Require a matching strong ETag (or *); otherwise returns 412.

parameters.name: If-Unmodified-Since
parameters.description: Require a representation unmodified since this HTTP date; ignored when If-Match is supplied.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Return 304 when an ETag matches, including weak comparison, or when * is supplied.

parameters.name: If-Modified-Since
parameters.description: Return 304 when the representation has not changed since this HTTP date; ignored when If-None-Match is supplied.

get.description: For a group repository, an asset ID from its browse or component listing resolves only while visible through the group's ordered members. Group assets are read-only.

delete.description: Deletes the stored generation identified by the asset ID. If a concurrent upload has replaced it, returns 404 and preserves the replacement and its companion metadata.

put.description: Only hosted and proxy repositories support download gates. Downloads through a group enforce the supplying member's gate.

Only hosted and proxy repositories support trust policies. Group repositories reject all modes; downloads through a group enforce the supplying member's policy, including its inherited instance default.

post.summary: Run a cleanup policy for a repository

get.summary: Get per-repository and per-blob-store storage usage
Get a local user and roles
Get roles assigned to a user

put.summary: Replace roles assigned to a user

post.description: The token secret is returned only by this request.

delete.description: Deleting a role also removes its direct user-role assignments. A role still referenced by an OIDC provider's default or group role mapping is rejected with 409 (code role_in_use_by_provider); remove the provider mappings first. A provisioning-managed role is rejected with 409 (code managed_resource) unless force=true.

409.description: Role is referenced by an OIDC provider mapping (role_in_use_by_provider) or is declaratively managed (managed_resource)

put.description: An omitted clientSecret preserves the existing secret.

post.summary: Run a cleanup policy across its repositories

put.summary: Create or replace a webhook by name
put.description: The path name is authoritative. Omitting secret preserves the existing secret; a new webhook requires one. Set enabled to false to deactivate delivery without deleting the subscription.

get.summary: Get scheduler status and configured job intervals

200.description: Scheduler status: the current cleanup lease (null when unheld) and configured job intervals

post.description: Invokes the builtin gc job. Task history remains under /api/v1/tasks.

Cross-checks each blob store's contents against the digests the metadata references and reports dangling references, orphans, and (when re-hashing) content that no longer matches its digest. Read-only; mutates nothing. Task history remains under /api/v1/tasks.

parameters.name: blobStore
parameters.description: Verify only this blob store; omit to verify every store.

parameters.name: rehash
parameters.description: Re-hash present, referenced blobs to detect bit-rot.

bearerAuth.description: Suxen API token or a configured OIDC bearer token. API-token scopes use repository:<name|*>:<read|write|delete|annotate|manage> and admin:<resource|*>:<action|*>. An empty scope list does not further restrict the user's roles.

oidcSession.name: suxen_oidc_token
oidcSession.description: HTTP-only browser session established by the configured OIDC login flow.

Location.description: Canonical path of the created resource.

AssetIfMatch.name: If-Match
AssetIfMatch.description: Current strong asset digest ETag, or a list containing it (including repeated header lines). A single bare digest is also accepted. Wildcard and weak ETags are rejected; prevents delayed scanner results from annotating a replacement generation

Page.name: page
Page.description: 1-based random-access page. Cannot be combined with cursor; pages do not enforce a collection snapshot.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque continuation cursor returned by the same operation and filters

SearchQuery.name: q
SearchQuery.description: Case-insensitive text query over repository, path, component, version, and attributes

Classification.name: classification
Classification.description: Match assets carrying this value under any classification.<key> label

RepositoryFilter.name: repository
RepositoryFilter.description: Exact repository name; repeat to select multiple repositories

AttributeFilter.name: attribute
AttributeFilter.description: Exact projected attribute filter in dot.path=value form; repeat to require multiple values

TokenScope.name: scope
TokenScope.description: Privilege scope; repeat the parameter or use comma-separated values

ProvisionDryRun.name: dryRun
ProvisionDryRun.description: Validate and report reconciliation decisions without mutating resources

ProvisionPrune.name: prune
ProvisionPrune.description: Delete provision-owned resources omitted from the desired state after reference validation

Force.name: force
Force.description: Transfer a managed resource out of declarative provisioning before applying the mutation

GracePeriod.name: grace
GracePeriod.description: Minimum unreferenced blob age as a Go duration

BadRequest.description: Invalid request. Account validation codes include invalid_username and password_required; the reserved repository name default returns reserved_repository_name.

Unauthorized.description: Authentication required. Control-plane routes answer 401 without a WWW-Authenticate challenge so browsers do not raise the native Basic-auth popup; clients authenticate with a bearer token or the cookie session and treat 401 as a prompt to sign in.

Conflict.description: Resource already exists, is declaratively managed, or is still referenced

UnsupportedMediaType.description: Request body must use a supported media type

ProvisioningDocument.description: Canonical HTTP desired-state envelope. Local file and command-line parsing additionally supports top-level lists, single resources, and JSONL before converting them to this envelope.

ProvisioningResource.description: One named control-plane resource. Specs are partial overlays: omitted scalar fields retain stored values, while nullable collection fields may be cleared before kind validation.

ProvisioningSecretReference.description: Server-local secret source. Exactly one source is required; values read from the source are never returned.

allowOverwrite.description: Hosted repositories only. Allow replacing an existing artifact with different content; identical retries remain idempotent. On creation defaults to true for Raw, OCI, Maven and Go, false for npm, Cargo and PyPI. Omission on update preserves the stored setting. Mutable format indexes remain updateable; digest-addressed OCI content remains immutable.

keepLast.description: Number of newest matching assets or format-defined complete units to retain per component, ranked by order. Go module versions form complete units: all .info, .mod, and .zip files must match the criteria, and incomplete versions are preserved. Maven retains whole base-version directories per groupId/artifactId, including classifiers and checksums; every file must match, and timestamped builds within one SNAPSHOT directory form one unit. Raw repositories with formatConfig components group matched assets by component; every asset sharing a pattern, component, and version forms one unit, whether the version is the parent directory or part of the file name. Formats without retention units count individual asset rows.

order.description: How keepLast ranks entries within a component. updatedAt keeps the most recently updated; version keeps the highest Raw component version or OCI tag, using semantic version precedence when both values parse as semver and natural (numeric-aware) order otherwise, with ties broken by update time. Entries without a version rank below versioned ones.

Problem.description: RFC 7807 problem details with a stable suxen error code.

ConfigurationReference.description: Reference to blob-store configuration resolved by the server. Configuration values are never returned.

BlobStoreUpdateRequest.description: Supply the existing driver and configuration reference unchanged; only operational attributes may be updated, including on the default store.

driver.description: Must match the stored driver; it cannot change after creation.

BlobStoreUsage.description: Physical occupancy of one blob store, split into referenced blobs still in use and unreferenced blobs a prune could reclaim.

BlobStoreAttributes.description: Operator-owned metadata for one physical blob store. uploadSessions controls transient upload retention and aggregate quotas.

staleAfter.description: Positive Go duration after which an inactive upload session is eligible for deletion.

maxStagedBytes.description: Maximum aggregate staged bytes in this blob store.

maxPrincipalStagedBytes.description: Maximum aggregate staged bytes owned by one authenticated principal.

maxPrincipalSessions.description: Maximum concurrent upload sessions owned by one authenticated principal.

loginProviders.description: OIDC providers that accept interactive browser login via /auth/oidc/{name}/login. Empty when SUXEN_OIDC_STATE_SECRET is not configured.

sessionProvider.description: For an oidc-session, the provider that issued it, so the UI can renew it via /auth/oidc/{name}/login?prompt=none before it expires.

expiresAt.description: For an oidc-session, the session's expiry as Unix seconds; the UI schedules a silent re-authentication ahead of it.

assets.description: Present on Raw component version rows: every member file, ordered by path. The row's assetId, digest, and reference (the path) then describe its first anchor file, size is the total, and updatedAt the newest member update.

RepositoryFormat.description: Repository format identifier. raw and oci are built in; other formats are provided by compile-time format plugins and rejected when absent from the running binary.

RepositoryFormatConfig.description: Format-owned repository settings validated by the owning format plugin (for example the Maven versionPolicy). Raw hosted and proxy repositories accept components, an ordered list of {pattern, anchor} rules: pattern is an RE2 expression with named groups name and version, and anchor is an optional RE2 expression that a file must match to establish a version directory. The first matching pattern assigns raw.component and raw.version; unmatched paths keep directory grouping. OCI accepts no configuration.

RepositoryEndpoints.description: Optional OCI registry roots besides /repository/{name}/v2/. Hosts match the request Host header without a port. Ports bind extra process listeners on the same address as SUXEN_LISTEN. Host matches win over port matches. Bare /v2/ on the primary listen port still maps to the repository named oci when nothing else claims the request.

items.description: DNS hostname or IPv4 address without a scheme, port, or path.

RepositoryCreateRequest.description: Create a hosted, proxy, or group repository. Group members are ordered existing hosted/proxy repositories of the same format; nested groups are invalid.

upstream.description: Proxy upstream endpoint; only embedded URL user information may rotate later.

members.description: Ordered existing hosted/proxy repositories of the same format; nested groups are invalid.

allowOverwrite.description: Hosted repositories only. Allow replacing an existing artifact with different content; identical retries remain idempotent. On creation defaults to true for Raw, OCI, Maven and Go, false for npm, Cargo and PyPI. Omission on update preserves the stored setting. Mutable format indexes remain updateable; digest-addressed OCI content remains immutable.

RepositoryUpdateRequest.description: Replace mutable settings, except that omitted upstream preserves the complete stored URL and credentials and omitted allowOverwrite preserves the replacement policy. Format, type, and proxy upstream endpoint cannot change; credentials in upstream URL user information may rotate. Group members remain ordered same-format leaves. Omitted formatConfig, members, and endpoints reset those fields to their defaults.

upstream.description: Omit to preserve the complete stored URL, including redacted credentials and query parameters. An explicit URL replaces credentials; the endpoint including its query must match the stored proxy endpoint. An empty URL is invalid for proxy repositories.

members.description: Ordered existing hosted/proxy repositories of the same format; nested groups are invalid.

allowOverwrite.description: Hosted repositories only. Allow replacing an existing artifact with different content; identical retries remain idempotent. On creation defaults to true for Raw, OCI, Maven and Go, false for npm, Cargo and PyPI. Omission on update preserves the stored setting. Mutable format indexes remain updateable; digest-addressed OCI content remains immutable.

Repository.description: Public repository definition. Internal repository IDs are never exposed; deleting and recreating a name creates isolated state.

allowOverwrite.description: Effective replacement policy. Present for hosted repositories only; identical retries are permitted.

path.description: Repository-relative asset path, at most 2048 UTF-8 bytes.

when.description: Predicate conditions over the projected asset attributes (AND). An empty list always matches.

key.description: Label key; the label is stored at classification.<key>.

inheritGlobal.description: When true, the instance-wide default classification rules are evaluated ahead of this repository's.
When true, the instance-wide default gate's criteria AND-extend this repository's.

DownloadGateUpdateRequest.description: Replaces the repository gate. criteria must be a non-null array; [] clears local criteria, while inherited criteria still apply unless inheritance is disabled. Missing or null criteria are rejected without changing policy or ownership.

DownloadGateDefaultsUpdateRequest.description: Replaces the instance-wide gate. criteria must be a non-null array; [] clears criteria. Missing or null criteria are rejected without changing policy or ownership.

UserUpdateRequest.description: Updates only supplied fields. An omitted admin field preserves the current value within the update transaction. An empty or omitted password preserves the current password.

UserRolesRequest.description: Replaces role assignments. roles must be a non-null array; [] clears assignments. Missing or null roles are rejected without changing assignments.

token.description: One-time bearer token secret. It is never returned again.

Predicate.description: One condition over the projected asset attribute view. All predicates in a policy criterion list must match. The reserved roots are sys, classification, provenance, and every registered format name returned in discovery.formats (including raw and oci). Stable projected paths are listed in x-suxen-reserved-paths and discovery.attributePaths; format plugins may expose additional paths under their reserved roots. classification.<key> addresses rule-assigned labels with dynamic keys. Other roots address writer-owned attribute namespaces.

value.description: Operator literal. Omit for exists and absent. Use a non-empty array for in and not-in, an RE2 string for matches, and RFC3339 or a non-negative duration using Go, d, w, mo, or y units for before and after. JSON numbers compare by exact decimal value, including large exponents and numbers nested in objects or arrays.
Operator literal. Omit for exists and absent.

cleanup.description: Configured cleanup-policy interval as a Go duration; 0s means disabled.

gc.description: Configured garbage-collection interval as a Go duration; 0s means disabled.

verify.description: Configured blob-store verify interval as a Go duration; 0s means disabled.

migrate.description: Configured blob-store migrate interval as a Go duration; 0s means disabled.

name.description: Ignored when the webhook name is supplied in the path.

blobStore.description: Set when collection was scoped to one blob store; absent for a global run.

staleStagingFiles.description: Abandoned generic staging files found on this replica by global GC.

staleStagingFilesDeleted.description: Abandoned generic staging files removed on this replica; zero for dry runs.
